concepts.proposed_markdown: - [[source-braintree-authorization-responses]] - processor authorization approvals, decline and network-response classes, hard-versus-soft handling, retry restrictions, and the some-market merchant-fee qualification
warnings: Keep processor approval distinct from a separate gateway rejection and do not infer capture or final settlement from `success`.
Do not turn soft-decline retryability into permission for unrestricted retries; preserve the network and recurring-ECI restrictions.
Keep the fee statement qualified to authorization and capture in some markets; the page does not say every attempt incurs a fee.
Leave the complete response-code inventory and code-specific implications in the raw source.

concepts.proposed_markdown: - [[source-braintree-authorization-responses]] - Braintree processor-decline categories and retry restrictions, including recurring-ECI limits and same-payment-information restrictions
warnings: Keep the 15-in-30-days and code-specific restrictions conditioned on transactions originally passed with a recurring ecommerce indicator flag.
Do not generalize the listed Braintree processor codes into universal cross-provider dunning rules.
